map.OR>1 为风险升高。: OR>1 means the risk is elevated.
map.OR=(a·d)/(b·c)，病例对照关联强度。: OR=(a·d)/(b·c), the association strength in case-control studies.
map.OR=1 无关联、>1 风险高、<1 保护。: OR=1 means no association, above 1 higher risk and below 1 a protective effect.
map.a=40(暴露病)、b=20(暴露无病)、c=30(无暴露病)、d=60(无暴露: a=40 (exposed with the disease), b=20 (exposed without), c=30 (unexposed with the disease), d=60 (unexposed without): OR=(40×60)/(20×30)=2400/600=4. The odds in the exposed group are four times those in the control group.
map.OR=0.5 表示暴露降低一半 odds（保护效应）。: OR=0.5 means exposure halves the odds (a protective effect).
map.OR 和 RR 区别？: How do OR and RR differ?
map.RR=发病率比（队列），OR=odds 比（病例对照）。罕见病 OR≈RR，常见: RR compares incidence rates (cohort studies) while OR compares odds (case-control studies). For rare diseases OR≈RR; for common ones OR overstates RR.
map.OR 能直接当风险倍数？: Can OR be read directly as a risk multiple?
map.仅当疾病罕见时近似，否则 OR 高于 RR，需谨慎解读。: Only approximately for rare diseases; otherwise OR exceeds RR and must be interpreted with care.
map.比值比 OR（本页代码口径）：OR=a×d÷(b×c)（a 暴露且结局、b 暴露: Odds ratio OR (as coded on this page): OR=a×d÷(b×c) (a exposed with outcome, b exposed without outcome, c unexposed with outcome, d unexposed without outcome), reciprocal OR=b×c÷(a×d); additional table: Woolf standard error se=√(1÷a+1÷b+1÷c+1÷d), 95%CI=exp(lnOR±1.96×se), χ²=n(ad−bc)²÷((a+b)(c+d)(a+c)(b+d)); event rates p₁=a÷(a+b), p₀=c÷(c+d), RR=p₁÷p₀, RR back-calculated from OR=OR÷((1−p₀)+p₀×OR), NNT=⌈1÷|p₁−p₀|⌉. Validation: empty values in the four cells trigger a prompt; the additional table also requires all four cells >0. Criteria: a 95%CI containing 1 is marked not significant (green); significant with OR≥2 or ≤0.5 is marked red "significant and substantial", otherwise orange; when both p₁ and p₀ are <0.10, a rare-disease approximation note is shown.
